_comment: Showdown question bank for AWS Cloud & AI Day Kuala Lumpur (2026-11-04, Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre). Separate from the Hanoi bank. 6 categories: agentic-ai, aws-core-services, security (refreshed from the live bank snapshot of 2026-10-05, same IDs, Vietnam-specific and stale entries rewritten in place), malaysia-aws, well-architected, cio-playbook (VIP: Shaown Nandi, 'The CIO's Playbook'). Drafted 2026-10-05; per-category drafts and change log in docs/my2026-draft/. Authoring rules: .kiro/skills/showdown-question-bank/SKILL.md.

_type_to_lock_mapping.word: word-lock only. Answers here are 3-6 letters, matched against word-lock's per-position reel constraint — NOT the same pool as 'spelling'.
_type_to_lock_mapping.mcq: wager-lock only (streak-lock was dropped from the lineup — see docs/quiz-mode-instructions-engine.md for why).
_type_to_lock_mapping.statement: pillar-lock ONLY, repurposed as True/False sorter within a single category. TEMPLATE FORMAT: {correctValue|wrongValue} slot — the client picks the True (left) or False (right) side per session.
_type_to_lock_mapping.spelling: spelling-lock only. Each entry's `answer` is the exact string passed into spelling-lock's `pool` config. Answers CAN be multi-word (e.g. 'Kiro Power', 'Direct Connect') — spelling-lock renders a visible gap between words in the slot layout and strips spaces only from the internal shuffled letter pool, so multi-word answers work fine and are not confusing. Rule applied when curating this array: letters and spaces only (no digits/symbols), 5-16 total letters excluding spaces. See docs/quiz-mode-instructions-engine.md for the length-range rationale. MALAYSIA BANK: every spelling entry also has a `question`, a fill-in-the-blank clue with exactly one ___ (the answer never appears in it). Needs the engine change in docs/showdown-spelling-clue-handoff.md; without it the clue is ignored.
